claims.claim: Moving Earth 1.0->2.7 AU in 10,000 yr requires dv = 11.658 km/s, dE = 1.668e33 J, F = 2.206e17 N.
claims.verdict: Matches exact two-body quasi-circular spiral kinematics.

claims.claim: Standoff distance d = 1.30e9 m yields Earth tidal acceleration ~1/3,000 of lunar tide.
claims.verdict: Matches Dawn gravimetry and analytical tidal formula.

claims.claim: 10% waste heat of 1e25 W beam delivers 6.01e18 W (34.6x solar constant) to Earth without shielding.
claims.verdict: Mathematically exact; proves unshielded monolithic tug vaporizes the biosphere.

claims.claim: In-ecliptic 0.3c beam deposits 3.6e28 J in Moon per 1-hr transit (30% of lunar binding energy).
claims.verdict: Mathematically exact; proves in-ecliptic thrusters will catastrophically blast the Moon.

claims.claim: Tilting twin thrusters +/-5.0 deg out of ecliptic gives 1.14e8 m vertical clearance, exceeding Moon's max excursion (3.45e7 m) by 3.3x.
claims.verdict: Defensible 3D geometry; completely protects Moon and Earth with 0.38% cosine penalty.

claims.claim: Applying 2.233e17 N directly to Moon perturbs Earth-Moon bond by only 0.113% and does not cause secular orbital runaway.
claims.verdict: The perturbation ratio is mathematically correct, but applying thrust TO the Moon requires either landing a 1e25 W engine on the lunar surface (violating waste heat and Moon retention rules) or hovering a tractor above the Moon (which re-creates the exact same tractor problem).

claims.claim: Resonant optical cavity with S_amp=250 reduces laser power to 1.32e23 W, but requires mirror aperture A >= 6.6e18 m^2 (radius 1.45e9 m).
claims.verdict: The mirror radius R = 1,450,000 km (228 Earth radii!) is larger than the Earth-Sun L1 distance and cannot be pointed or stabilized as an optical resonator across 1 AU.

claims.claim: Active star-lifting extracts 2.44e9 kg/s from solar corona to refuel tug with hydrogen.
claims.verdict: Lifting and accelerating 2.44e9 kg/s to 0.3c requires 1.06e25 W at the Sun. Intercepting a diffuse gas stream across 1 AU without beam dispersion is unmodeled and relies on an unverified sci-fi concept beyond 3 enablers.

claims.claim: Gravity tractor open-loop instability parameter k = 3.629e-13 s^-2 yields e-folding time constant tau = 19.21 days.
claims.verdict: Proves gravity tractor can be stably controlled with low-frequency PID loops.
